problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2\text{i}-1 & 0 \\ 2\text{i} & 1\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following  elementary row operations:

$$
{R}_{1}=\frac{1}{2\text{i}-1}{R}_{1},\,{R}_{2}={R}_{2}-2\text{i}{R}_{1}
$$
worked_solution:
Let's apply the row operations to $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}2\text{i}-1 & 0 \\ 2\text{i} & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{2\text{i}-1}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 2\text{i} & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-2\text{i}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the result is

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$
